# Vendored model attribution

## macmini_m4.stl

A detailed Mac mini M4 model, used **only** as a prop in the assembly hero
render (`src/mac_mini/mini_claw_chain_scene.scad`). It is not a printable
part of this project and is not attached to releases.

- **Author:** Satyr (@Satyr on Printables)
- **Source:** https://www.printables.com/model/1057608-mac-mini-m4
- **License:** [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)

The mesh file is used unmodified; the scene only positions, flips, and
colours it at render time. Used with attribution per the CC BY 4.0 terms.
